name: Atano Rio
source:
The protagonist of the [rēve parfait] games.

Rio is Reon and Aki's childhood friend. She is a serious girl who works as her class' president. During the summer of her second year in middle school, she began dating Reon but broke up due to a certain reason. From then on, Rio hasn't ever fallen in love again.

[Translation of [URL=http://www.honeybee-cd.com/dynamic/reve/append.html]official website character profile[/URL].]
